source: ECOSORN project leaflet, "សណ្តែកសៀង (ពូជក្នុងស្រុក)" [Soybean (local varieties)], 2-page farmer extension leaflet
text: The leaflet promotes locally-adapted soybean varieties (ពូជក្នុងស្រុក) over imported ones for smallholder farmers, on the basis that local varieties are already adjusted to Cambodian rainfall and soil conditions and require less specialized input management. Farmers are advised to select clean, uniform, disease-free seed before the season and to test germination rate before large-scale sowing.
